note: Case geography for the map view (GridSim reads case-level geography.json from 2.1.003; older builds ignore it). ERCOT weather zones are approximated from county assignments (estimated).

projection.formula: x = m + (1-2m)*(lon-west)/(east-west); y = m + (1-2m)*(lat-south)/(north-south); clamped to [0,1]; north is y=1 (drawn at 1-y on screen)
projection.note: State of Texas box S 25.6, W -106.8, N 36.7, E -93.3 (regions.json 'ercot-spine'), margin 0.03
